description: KiwiRail publishes risk ratings for rail structures, especially bridges, from its Maximo asset-management system. The stated purpose is to prioritise maintenance, renewals and mitigation such as flood protection, including lifelines and emergency planning. Point and line layers expose condition, strength, fatigue, foundation, seismic, scour, strike and health-index fields. Scores were not retrieved or independently assessed. This structures-specific view is separate from the already catalogued network-section risk and freight-disruption layers. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing KiwiRail network-risk and freight-disruption layers.
